confidence_interval_method.by_world: Resample the same ten seed IDs within the named fixed world.
confidence_interval_method.interval_scope: Conditional descriptive variability across repeated seeds in these two fixed, previously examined worlds; not uncertainty across unseen worlds or the full benchmark.
confidence_interval_method.task_success_CI_omitted: All observed success indicators are zero; a degenerate bootstrap interval is not reported as evidence that the population success probability is exactly zero.
confidence_interval_method.within_budget_pooling: Resample the 10 policy sampling seed IDs jointly across both fixed worlds; average both worlds per seed before the bootstrap mean. Both arms use identical draws.

variance_definition: Sample variance uses n-1. Paired differences are formed within identical group/budget/seed before variance/SD. n<2 variance and SD are null.
